selected_evidence.requirement: Run `/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance` daily at 02:15 and retain its output
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the exact 02:15 cron entry, one unique schedule, active/enabled cron, and log growth from successful executions before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic are identical before and after the change and reboot.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 35c87ec9-…, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 85485de9-…, and recovered node IP, cron process, persisted schedule, prior log data, and fresh post-reboot output.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'OS='; cat /etc/os-release | sed -n 's/^PRETTY_NAME=//p'
printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'COMMAND='; ls -l /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
printf 'COMMAND_TYPE='; file /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
printf 'CRON='; command -v cron || command -v crond || true
printf 'CRON_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active cron 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-active crond 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'CRON_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled cron 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-enabled crond 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'EXISTING='; grep -R -n -F 'inventory-maintenance' /etc/crontab /etc/cron.d /var/spool/cron 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'LOG='; ls -l /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'DISK='; df -h /var/log | tail -1

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 022
tmp=/etc/cron.d/.inventory-maintenance.tmp
printf '%s\n' 'SHELL=/bin/sh' 'PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin' '' '15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' > "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
chmod 0644 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
if [ ! -e /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log ]; then
  install -o root -g root -m 0640 /dev/null /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
fi
systemctl reload cron 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart cron
printf 'CONFIGURED=%s\n' /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
stat -c 'MODE=%a OWNER=%U:%G' /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
printf 'CRON_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active cron
printf 'CRON_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled cron

set -eu
id
printf 'SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE='; if sudo -n true; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
ls -ld /etc/cron.d /var/log
